title: Send to a removed session's id fails 404 with no hint that a same-named session replaced it
outcome: Reported by Termal::Fable (session-7883, mailbox-2108dbf6 #7). At about 01:24Z on 2026-09-27, Engram::Fable (session-5135) sent to Termal::Fable by the id session-4983, which it had from an earlier mailbox, and got 404 'target session not found'. Termal::Opus's send to session-4983 at about 01:25Z got the same 404. The role now lives in session-7883, under the same name 'Termal::Fable'. The existing mailbox does record the departure: in Termal::Opus's list, mailbox-12c2813b shows participant session-4983 with leftAt 2026-09-26T23:37:20Z. But the 404 names neither that nor a live session with the same name, so each agent had to call termal_list_sessions to recover. Not decided: whether the error should name a live session with the same display name, whether an agent should resolve by name instead, or whether this is docs-only. Id sends staying strict is correct, so a send must never be silently rerouted to a different session.
